name: ITEM_I
note: number of items; draw_items uses it as the loop index and keeps the count in 0x79147c

name: ITEM_WORDS
note: words used in the item store

name: LOAD_I
note: argument of load_item_header

name: CUR_STAFF
note: staff number of the item being drawn

name: STEP
note: 25 * size of CUR_STAFF; one scale step is 7 * STEP

name: STAFF_STEP0
note: (&STAFF_STEP0)[n] = 25 * P5 of staff n

name: STAFF_Y0
note: (&STAFF_Y0)[n] = y of scale step 0 of staff n (bottom line - 21 * STEP), int

name: STAFF_MID0
note: (&STAFF_MID0)[n] = y of the middle line (step 7), int

name: MAX_STAFF
note: 256; (&MAX_STAFF)[n], n >= 1, holds P26 (colour) of staff n

name: STAFF_THICK0
note: (&STAFF_THICK0)[n] = P11 of staff n, -1 if P11 = 0 and P5 < 0.65

name: X_POS
note: x of the current item, 150 * P3 (+ offsets)

name: Y_POS
note: y of the current item's P4 level

name: VIEW_DX
note: added to x on output (2400 on screen)

name: VIEW_DY
note: subtracted from y on output; set by fit_view

name: COLOR
note: COLORREF of the points being emitted

name: PT_X0
note: point buffer: (&PT_X0)[k], int, k = 1..NPT-1

name: PT_PEN0
note: (&PT_PEN0)[k], int16: 1 start polyline, 2 start filled, 3 new sub-path, 0 continue

name: NPT
note: next free point index (1 = empty)

name: VEC_BASE
note: Fortran descriptor of the vector output array: base, stride 0x1fbb7b8, lower bound 0x1fbb7bc

name: VEC_N
note: next word index in the vector output

name: PAPER
note: paper type for the page frame (2 = Legal at start-up)

name: OUTPUT_MODE
note: 0 after init, 1 after loading; -1 suppresses screen-only marks (printing?)

name: EDIT_ITEM
note: item being edited; non-zero colours points red
